blocks.title: Three Rules That Hold
blocks.text: Env vars freeze at container start. Volume mounts update live via the ..data symlink flip. subPath mounts never update. Memorize these three.

caption.text: Part 3 of KUBERNETES CONFIG HANDBOOK. You edited the ConfigMap, the Pod still serves the old value, and two hours vanish. Here is why: env vars freeze at container start, volume mounts update live through an atomic ..data symlink flip, and subPath mounts never update at all. 10 pages of dense notes on ConfigMaps and Secrets — base64 vs real encryption, immutability, rotation with overlap, projected volumes, and the debug order that finds it in 60 seconds.
